newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedbank sees Sweden state need 4 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedbank sees Sweden state need 4 bln SKR.

text.p: Swedish bank Swedbank forecast on Monday that the country's borrowing requirement will be around four billion crowns in March, which would be two billion crowns lower than in March 1996.
"The underlying improvement in state finances continues but at a somewhat slower rate than earlier," the bank said in its weekly letter.
But recent market turmoil with higher interest rates and a softer crown might increase costs related to state debt, the bank said.
"It is, however, uncertain if the National Debt Office will take this into account in this forecast," the bank said.
"If it does, we see its full-year forecast revised upwards by five billion crowns to the interval 25-35 billion crowns."
The debt office will publish its next forecast on February 11 at 0830 GMT.
